transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

I just... I don't really care about anything anymore. Um. I used to do things, like... art classes, or board-game nights. Hiking. I was supposed to get back to my soccer team, but... I don't know. I just sit in my room now. It feels like everything is just... slipping away.
How long have you been feeling this way—like you don't care about the things you used to enjoy?

Um... I don't know exactly. It feels like a long time. I guess... maybe since last summer? It just got to where it was all the time. So... maybe a year and some months. Like a year and four months, I think.
Have you ever had a period—lasting several days or more—where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or needed much less sleep than normal, even if it felt good at the time?
No... I don't think so. I'm usually just... tired.

During this past year and four months, have there been any stretches—say, a couple of months or more—when you felt more like your normal self, or has this low, uninterested feeling been pretty much constant the whole time?

Um... no. Not really. It's been pretty constant. Most of the time since... since this all started, I haven't just been, you know, scared or... confused. I've mostly just been deeply depressed. I'm barely interested in anything at all. It just... I don't know, it feels like my life is already over. So... no normal stretches.
Before this period started about a year and four months ago, had you ever gone through a separate episode of feeling this depressed and uninterested in things, at some earlier point in your life?
Um... no. I don't think so. Just... just since it all started last year. I don't really remember feeling like this before.
